verdict.rationale: Buzz is a self-hostable team chat and collaboration relay, so message retention and legal holds are a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no retention-policy configuration, legal-hold capability, or eDiscovery export. Agent audit trails, six-month history search and moderation reports are adjacent features, not retention enforcement.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce message retention policies and legal holds for compliance and eDiscovery
